_what: GEOM-Drugs row of paper Table 21 (PoseBusters validity before/after MFM guidance)

selected_run_n64.note: the run the paper's 87.5% comes from; its own unsteered arm is also 87.5%

rerun_n4096x3.note: 11 of 12 shards (seed 21 crashed on a 72-atom target); mean over shards of the per-shard PB fraction

mismatch: No record measures the base model's PB validity on 4,096 molecules. The 92.0% in Table 21 coincides with the training-time validation PB (100 molecules, no-strain config) at epochs 26, 28 and 37; the selected epoch-38 checkpoint logged 98.0% there. The unsteered arms of the two runs that produced the multiMFM number give 87.5% (n=64) and 88.0% (n=4096x3) with the GEOM PB config.
_precision: paper.* values printed with a fixed number of decimals are stored as the printed literal STRING (thousands separators dropped) so notebooks/_common.py compare() derives the exact tolerance; JSON numbers lose trailing zeros (92.0 -> 92.0 reads back fine but 87.50 would not). records.* are recomputed values and stay numeric.
